labeler.model_resolution: Requested as the `opus` alias through the Claude Code Agent tool, because no provider API key is present in this environment. Recorded as claude-opus-5, the same pin the inv-002 proposer carries (scripts/run_proposer.py MODEL). The harness does not return an exact model-id string to the caller, so this stamp is a declaration of the alias requested, not a value read back from an API response. An API-key run through backend `anthropic_api` records the resolved id and should be preferred whenever a key is available.
labeler.gold_visibility_note: The labeler sees contract text and the target definition. It never sees any gold annotation, its own or another category's, and it never sees model output. D-24 permits applicability to read gold; this pipeline declines that permission, so a gold-gated label (the D-21 failure mode that sank 13 of 23 pilot checkers) is structurally impossible rather than merely screened for.
